title: Polymerization of 1,3-butadiene catalyzed by Co(II) and Ni(II) complexes of 6,6′-dihydroxy-2,2′-bipyridine ligands: 1,4-cis-polymerization versus isospecific 1,2-polymerization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12557-12562
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00928F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shinji Yamakawa, Daisuke Takeuchi, Kohtaro Osakada, Shigenaga Takano, Shojiro Kaita
CoCl2(dhbp) and NiBr2(dhbp) catalyze cis-1,4-selective polymerization of 1,3-butadiene. Addition of 5-norbornene-2-methyl amine in the polymerization catalyzed by NiBr2(dhbp)/MAO caused a marked change in the microstructure to the iso-1,2-structure.
